kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic يُوحَنَّا الْمَعْمَدَان (yūḥannā l-maʕmadān)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic معمداني
From يُوحَنَّا الْمَعْمَدَان (yūḥannā l-maʕmadān, “John the Baptist”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
g: Baptist (adherent of a Protestant denomination (or various subdenominations) of Christianity)
